messages:
sai: heads-up — opened a tiny rename PR to normalize identifier casing in kv cache helpers (camelCase -> snake_case). PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2101. planning to land in today's merge window if no blocking nits.
megan: skimmed — overall OK. one small grep nit: `cacheKey` still shows up in two places, pls swap to `cache_key` so linter doesn't complain.
jess: ran `gofmt` + `golangci-lint` locally, linter flags an unused var in `kv_cache.go:42` (leftover from a refactor). i can push a tiny cleanup if you want.
omar: I can take the unused var fix and the remaining `cacheKey` rename, will push a follow-up commit to this branch. do we want squash-merge or keep commits separate?
sai: prefer squash to keep history tidy for this tiny change. also CI shows one flaky: `TestKVCacheRace` on linux, @ci-bot can you re-run CI for the PR?
ci-bot: CI: rebuild queued for PR #2101 (run id 202). rerun triggered by @sai.
omegan: also rebase onto main to pick up the pre-commit fmt hook change (that caused the big diff noise earlier).
omar: rebased + pushed, and fixed the unused var + two `cacheKey` occurrences. PTAL. (commit: `fix(varcase): rename cacheKey -> cache_key, remove unused var`).
jess: quick local check — lints are clean now. left one tiny test name nit in `kv_cache_test.go` (snake_case -> camelCase inconsistency). not blocking but consistent naming would be nice.
sai: yeah please rename the test to snake_case to match package style.
megan: LGTM after test rename and CI green :thumbsup:
omar: updated test name and force-pushed. thanks all.
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #2101 (run id 202).
sai: merging in 30m if no objections. tagging for the afternoon merge window.
omegan: :eyes: go for it.
ci-bot: GitHub: PR #2101 merged by sai.
sai: merged and deployed infra patch. thanks everyone :tada:
